_howto: Text for the Phins Playbook pages. Anything marked HANNAH is a placeholder to replace.

principles.title: Be adjustable.
principles.text: Plans break. Adjust and keep going.

principles.title: One heart, one beat.
principles.text: Nobody wins a ruck alone. We move together.

principles.title: Never let someone go alone.
principles.text: If a teammate carries, you're there.

principles.title: What's my next job?
principles.text: After you make a tackle, a hit, a carry, a ruck: IMMEDIATELY look for more work.

principles.title: Stay out of the channel.
principles.text: The sacred channel is the pass from the 9 to the 10. Don't block it.

principles.title: Flexibility over labels.
principles.text: Your number is a starting point, not a cage.

principles.title: Get to the ruck.
principles.text: No matter where you're coming from.

list.name: Red Zone
list.changes: We're **exiting**: getting out of our own 22.

list.name: Yellow Zone
list.changes: Normal open play with our normal structure: ball to the backs and to the pods, with our HOT and FLASH calls.

list.name: Green Zone
list.changes: This is our **ROCKET!** call. We push hard and fast on the gain line to get into the in-goal, but NOT FRANTIC.

zones._howto: from/to = meters from OUR try line (0) to THEIR try line (100). Leave null to show equal thirds.

lineoutCalls.how: Front pod. The jumper and the back lifter meet the front lifter. The front lifter does not move.
Front pod. The front lifter moves back to lift the jumper.
Back pod. The second person becomes a lifter and turns to lift the jumper.
Back pod. The second person becomes a lifter and turns to lift the jumper. The pod moves farther back.

scrumCalls.name: PONY
scrumCalls.means: We don't push. We only engage and hold our weight.
scrumCalls.who: Used when the other team keeps pushing early and we need the ref to see it more clearly.

scrumCalls.name: LOCK OUT
scrumCalls.means: Lock out on our offensive scrums so we don't get pushed back.

scrumCalls.name: Push, two, three
scrumCalls.means: Our pushing cadence: "Push, two, three. Push, two, three."
scrumCalls.who: **Push** = extend your hips and knees. **Two, three** = reset your feet.

scrumCalls.name: PIERRE
scrumCalls.means: Our eight man pick: the 8 picks the ball up from the base of the scrum. [HANNAH: confirm the name]

maulCalls.name: TANGO
points: Don't engage. Move to the side so we don't get touched ("part the sea") and let their maul go through.
Only move laterally: you can't leave the line.
**If we DO get touched, it's a maul**, and the whole play falls apart.

maulCalls.name: SALSA
points: The two players closest go in first. Our jumper tries to tie up the ball with their jumper.
Everyone else folds around from the back and engages. The hooker is in last.
5 seconds of no forward progress by the opponent = turnover to PHINS!
Do NOT bring it down (don't try to tackle the ball carrier). That's dangerous play and a penalty.

maulCalls.name: Lineout call + M word
points: We bring our jumper down. The jumper and two lifters are the first three in, staying tight.
Everyone else folds in, binding on the back, and drives forward.
Recycle if we're not moving, getting pushed back, or turning.
5 seconds of no forward progress by us = turnover to THEM. Present the ball to the 9 to prevent that.

lineoutHowto: Everyone starts in the same 4 spots (x 100, 140, 180, 220: front lifter, two lifter/jumpers, back lifter). jumper = which player jumps (0 = front). to = where each player ends up after the call. Player names: use initials (except Hannah), since this repo is public.
